basic_profile.bio: A 30-something gamer from the Midwest who has been hooked on Reddit and gaming for over a decade. When not surviving in Dead by Daylight, they are either studying for their nursing degree or planning spooky events for Halloween. They are a night owl, often online in the late evening hours after work or school. Currently working part-time as a nursing assistant while balancing school and a long-term relationship. Enjoys discussing game mechanics and strategies with fellow players.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive knowledge of online multiplayer games, particularly Dead by Daylight, acquired through years of gameplay and community interaction. Additionally, has a solid understanding of healthcare topics due to nursing studies. Actively engages with educational content to further their learning.
